## Goal
- Complete and production-verify secure Phase 1 IVX Member Registration through the canonical GitHub PR/CI/Render lifecycle, using Render-held credentials through the deployed owner control plane rather than repeatedly requesting secret values.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Canonical repository: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; production branch: `main`; Render service: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`.
- Use a fresh authenticated clone of canonical remote `main`; local HEAD must equal remote `main`; clean working tree; no Rork-router source; no local-only commits.
- Never modify `main` directly or deploy from `ivx-autonomous`; create `fix/member-registration-phase1-final`.
- Required lifecycle: isolated branch → tests → commit → PR → CI pass → owner approval where required → merge → Render → `/health` + `/version` → SHA-parity evidence.
- Owner approval is required for production deployment, database/RLS/auth/payment changes, destructive actions, secret rotation, production signing, and infrastructure mutation.
- Do not extract, print, paste, or expose Render/GitHub/AWS credential values; inspect only configured key names and use the deployed owner-gated GitHub control plane for credential-backed actions.
- Do not claim `CODE_COMPLETE` without a PR, `DEPLOYED` without a Render deployment ID, or `VERIFIED` without live registration/session/redirect success.
- Final status must be exactly `MEMBER_REGISTRATION_LIVE_VERIFIED` or `MEMBER_REGISTRATION_NOT_VERIFIED`.
- Phase 1 fields only: first name, last name, date of birth, optional gender, mobile phone, email, password, confirm password, and terms/privacy acceptance.
- Do not collect ZIP/postal code, investment interests, KYC/AML, SSN, passports, source of funds, bank data, accredited status, tax forms, or legal agreements during Phase 1 registration.
- OTP email/phone verification, secure persistent session creation, and redirect to IVX Home are required after registration.
- Phase 2 profile completion must be optional, resumable, auto-saved, and show 25%/50%/75%/100% completion.
- Phase 3 Investor Verification may begin only through explicit investment-intent actions such as `Start Investing`, `Invest Now`, or `Participate in this Deal`.
- Native Supabase Auth is the required identity model for email/password and phone OTP; do not mix it with Rork Auth.
- Authorized delivery verification: `561-644-3503` / `+15616443503` and `iperez4242@gmail.com`, only after backend configuration is safely confirmed.
- P0 acceptance requires three consecutive canonical-`main` passes for `IVX CI`, `IVX QA Suite`, `IVX E2E Acceptance`, `Android Emulator QA`, and `iOS Simulator QA`.

## Progress
### Done
- Public production runtime probes passed:
  ```text
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 20 https://api.ivxholding.com/health
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 20 https://api.ivxholding.com/version
  ```
- `/health` currently returned:
  ```json
  {
    "ok": true,
    "status": "healthy",
    "commit": "012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c",
    "bootTime": "2026-08-03T00:56:48.348Z",
    "credentials": null,
    "github": null,
    "render": null
  }
  ```
  - Public health output is redacted and cannot prove Render credential readiness.
- `/version` returned:
  ```json
  {
    "ok": true,
    "service": "ivx-owner-ai-backend",
    "commit": "012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c",
    "commitShort": "012bb088",
    "bootTime": "2026-08-03T00:56:48.348Z"
  }
  ```
- OTP-send endpoint CORS preflight passed:
  ```text
  curl --silent --show-error --max-time 20 --request OPTIONS https://api.ivxholding.com/api/members/send-phone-code --write-out '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' --output /dev/null
  HTTP 204
  ```
- Live invalid-registration contract passed safely:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/members/register
  HTTP 400
  ```
  ```json
  {
    "ok": false,
    "code": "INVALID_EMAIL",
    "message": "Please enter a valid email address.",
    "traceId": "ivx-reg-mscj86n8-mgfh4c79",
    "stage": "VALIDATING",
    "retryable": false,
    "deploymentMarker": "ivx-members-api-v1"
  }
  ```
- Focused registration regression suite passed:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts
  13 pass
  0 fail
  45 expect() calls
  ```
- Confirmed existing transport/service locations:
  ```text
  backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts
  backend/services/ivx-sns-sms.ts
  backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts
  ```
- Confirmed `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` declares:
  ```text
  DEPLOYMENT_MARKER = 'ivx-member-verification-v2-fallback-store'
  CODE_TTL_MINUTES = 10
  CODE_LENGTH = 6
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  ```
  - It has a Supabase-to-durable/filesystem fallback because required verification schema/columns were missing.
- Confirmed `expo/lib/member-service.ts` defines `RegisterPayload` with required `gender`, `country`, `zipCode`, and `roles`, contrary to Phase 1 requirements.
- Reviewed `.rork/skills/auth/SKILL.md`: email/password and phone OTP require native Supabase Auth; Rork Auth must not be mixed with Supabase identity/session flows.
- Reviewed signup UI entry points:
  - `expo/app/member-register.tsx` directly imports `supabase`, `MemberService`, `expo-image-picker`, and legacy `expo-file-system`.
  - `expo/app/signup.tsx` imports `useAuth`, `resetOwnerLocalSignupState`, and `findExistingRegisteredMemberByEmail`.
- Local Android client release build completed successfully:
  ```text
  runChecks
  appPath=android-ivx-holdings
  framework=kotlin
  success=true
  ```
- Confirmed deployed GitHub/Render automation exists in `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`:
  - `runGithubGetRepoHead(...)` reads repository information and calls GitHub using `githubHeaders()`.
  - GitHub mutations are designed to run against the credential held by the deployed backend and return `secretValuesReturned: false`.
- Requested `RENDER_API_KEY` through the environment manager; it returned:
  ```text
  status=already_set
  ```
  - No secret was requested or displayed.

### In Progress
- Use the deployed owner-gated developer-deploy control plane to verify GitHub repository access without extracting `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Establish the canonical `main` baseline through the Render-held GitHub credential, then create `fix/member-registration-phase1-final`.
- Repair Phase 1 registration contract, secure OTP delivery/storage, and client session flow.
- Consolidate `expo/app/member-register.tsx` and `expo/app/signup.tsx` into authoritative native-Supabase registration behavior.
- Add focused backend and Expo security/registration regression coverage.
- Run backend, TypeScript, lint, secret-scan, Android/iOS/web, and session-flow validation.
- Open canonical PR, collect CI evidence, then deploy an approved merge and verify live SHA parity.

### Blocked
- The current shell does not receive any GitHub, Render, or owner credentials:
  ```text
  GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RENDER_API_KEY=not-injected
  IVX_OWNER_TOKEN=missing
  IVX_OWNER_PASSWORD=missing
  IVX_OWNER_EMAIL=missing
  RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  ```
- Although the environment manager says `RENDER_API_KEY` is already set, all direct Render API calls from this sandbox fail before network access:
  ```text
  RENDER_API_KEY=not-injected
  ```
- The deployed backend can safely use the Render-held GitHub credential, but invoking its owner-gated status/action endpoint requires a valid owner session/bearer; none is available in this shell.
- No fresh authenticated canonical clone, repair branch, implementation commit, dedicated PR, CI pass, owner approval, merge, Render deployment, or canonical SHA-parity evidence exists yet.
- The deployed runtime SHA `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c` does not match the noncanonical local SHA `2a27e3107f26a4450428556442a6b69bcd91ed4a`.
- No safe evidence proves Render’s current member OTP configuration can successfully publish SNS SMS or send SES email.
- AWS access key may have been exposed in an attachment while entering `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`; treat it as compromised.
- SNS sandbox/production access, spend limit, origination/sender requirements, destination eligibility, and actual SMS receipt remain unverified.
- SES sender identity, `IVX_SES_FROM_EMAIL`, SES sandbox/recipient status, and actual email receipt remain unverified.
- Backend logs are unavailable through the current Rork CLI:
  ```text
  rork-agent logs backend --limit 100 | rg -i 'members|registration|otp|ses|sns|error'
  No backend logs found for this project.
  ```
- P0 final acceptance remains blocked by lack of three consecutive passing canonical-`main` workflow runs.
- Local workspace has dependency/typecheck limitations:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'bun'.
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
  ```
  ```text
  Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-acm' from '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-audit-report.ts'
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Do not ask the user to paste the GitHub token repeatedly or retrieve/print a token from Render.
- Prefer the deployed `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` owner-gated control plane for canonical GitHub reads/writes, because its `githubHeaders()` uses the Render-held token and suppresses secret return values.
- Treat the direct shell `RENDER_API_KEY` injection failure as an environment-delivery issue, not evidence that Render lacks the credential.
- Use existing `backend/services/ivx-sns-sms.ts` as the SNS transport rather than adding a vendor/dependency, but never use `IVX_OWNER_RECOVERY_PHONE` as a member OTP destination.
- Use existing `backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts` as the SES transactional email transport rather than a Rork/SendGrid placeholder.
- Treat Member Registration, optional profile completion, and Investor Verification as separate flows.
- Remove mandatory ZIP and market/investment-interest selection from Phase 1.
- Keep date of birth required and gender optional.
- Preserve `/kyc-verification` as Phase 3 only, behind explicit investment-intent actions such as `Invest Now — Start KYC`.
- Replace simulated alternate-signup OTP behavior with authoritative backend send/verify calls or retire the duplicate route.
- Use one native Supabase Auth identity model; do not mix Rork Auth and Supabase Auth.
- Do not represent OTPs as delivered unless SES/SNS provider success and authorized-recipient receipt are directly evidenced.
- Rotate potentially exposed AWS credentials before production delivery testing; secrets must only be entered in private Render environment values.
- Do not certify end-to-end deployment from health/version and unit tests alone.

## Next Steps
1. Obtain an owner session through the approved passwordless owner flow or existing owner-authenticated control surface; do not paste or expose GitHub/Render secrets.
2. Call deployed `GET /api/ivx/developer-deploy/status` and/or the `github_get_repo_head` developer-deploy action using owner authorization to verify `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, canonical `main`, GitHub read/push capability, and credential readiness without returning token values.
3. Use the deployed GitHub action path to create `fix/member-registration-phase1-final` from verified canonical `main`; all GitHub writes must use:
   ```text
   confirm=true
   confirmText="CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"
   ```
4. If direct Render API audit remains needed, fix environment injection for the already-configured `RENDER_API_KEY`; query only service metadata, environment key names, and deployment metadata.
5. Obtain owner approval to rotate the possibly exposed `ivx-sns-production` access key; replace the Render secret privately and redeploy only through the approved lifecycle.
6. Verify backend-only Render environment key presence, without returning values:
   ```text
   AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
   AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
   AWS_REGION=us-east-1
   IVX_SES_FROM_EMAIL
   ```
7. Verify AWS SNS SMS region, sandbox/production access, spend limit, destination eligibility, and sender/origination settings; verify SES sender identity and sandbox/recipient status.
8. Update `backend/api/ivx-members.ts` to use validated submitted destinations and call `sendSesEmail(...)`/`sendSnsSms(...)` only after secure OTP persistence and rate-limit checks.
9. Replace plaintext OTP persistence with cryptographic hashes; implement expiry, attempt limit, resend cooldown/invalidation, immediate-use invalidation, replay protection, account/email/phone/IP limits, concurrency safety, and provider message-ID persistence.
10. Normalize email to lowercase and phone to E.164; enforce safe unique email/phone behavior, non-enumerating duplicate responses, and atomic/compensating user/profile creation.
11. Update `expo/lib/member-service.ts`, `expo/app/member-register.tsx`, and `expo/app/signup.tsx` for approved Phase 1 fields, authoritative API send/verify state, and native Supabase session persistence.
12. Route `expo/app/landing.tsx` `landing-member-register` and all alternate signup entry points to the authoritative flow.
13. Add/run backend, integration, Expo, Android, iOS, web, secret scan, and provider non-production delivery tests; include OTP misuse, resend, concurrency, duplicate, weak-network, restart, and redirect coverage.
14. Commit only Phase 1 changes, push branch, open one PR into `main`, and collect required CI evidence.
15. After approval and merge, capture merge SHA, Render deployment ID and deployed SHA; require equality across GitHub `main`, CI-tested SHA, Render, `/health`, and `/version`.
16. After credential rotation, provider readiness, deployment, and approval, perform authorized live SMS/email receipt tests using `+15616443503` and `iperez4242@gmail.com`.
17. Run and record three consecutive canonical-`main` passes for all required P0 workflows.
